project_trigger: C04 Mountain Fluid Rest v1.4 was rejected because dimensions were not sufficiently attached to the model read.
truth_boundary: Existing C04 scale-test values reused for training only; not field/site measurement; NTS; no engineering/accessibility approval.

design_crit.v1: REJECT — detached register contains correct values but object interval is ambiguous.
design_crit.v2: REVISE — attachment works but the vertical dimension cluster competes with silhouette/human scale.
design_crit.v3: KEEP FOR TRAINING — critical dimensions attach directly; secondary values move to a near-read rail; model/human scale remains first-read.

candidate_rule: SOURCE VALUE -> MEASURED OBJECT / INTERVAL -> ATTACHMENT CARRIER -> FIRST-READ MODEL -> NEAR-READ DIMENSION -> TRUTH BOUNDARY
external_reference: ISO 129-1:2018 general principles for presentation of dimensions and tolerances; applicable to 2D and can also be applied to 3D applications.
